title: ERC-8004 core objects
caption: The objects of the Draft text and how they refer to each other. The registration file and the feedback file are off-chain JSON; the other classes are contract storage or events. Feedback, ValidationStatus and MetadataEntry are struct names from the reference contracts and the text; the other class names are descriptive labels for objects the text leaves unnamed. Field names follow the text of 2026-01-25.
alt: Class diagram. AgentIdentity has agentId, owner, agentURI and the reserved agentWallet key, and links to any number of MetadataEntry items with metadataKey and metadataValue. RegistrationFile has type, name, description, image, services, x402Support, active, registrations and supportedTrust. Service has name, endpoint, version, skills, domains. Registration has agentId and agentRegistry and names an AgentIdentity. Feedback has value, valueDecimals, tag1, tag2 and isRevoked, keyed by client and feedbackIndex, and points through feedbackURI in the event to FeedbackFile. FeedbackFile has agentRegistry, agentId, clientAddress, createdAt, value, valueDecimals, optional mcp, a2a and oasf objects and an optional proofOfPayment. ProofOfPayment has fromAddress, toAddress, chainId and txHash. ValidationStatus, in a registry that is not officially deployed, has requestHash, validatorAddress, agentId, response, responseHash, tag and lastUpdate.
